name: Memoriam
source:
Memoriam is about Nat - a boy who lives a life filled with fun and love. He's blessed with lifelong friends and a sense of adventure. Did you know? Nat is going on his first date today! I wonder who it's with...

[From [url=https://asupnico.itch.io/memoriam-unfinished-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Memoriam》讲述男孩Nat的故事。他的生活充满乐趣与爱，拥有相伴一生的好友，也有一颗向往冒险的心。你知道吗？Nat今天要去进行第一次约会！不知道对方会是谁呢……

[摘自[url=https://asupnico.itch.io/memoriam-unfinished-demo]itch.io[/url]]
